name: LauncherCtrlId
meaning: Control ids in dialogs 0x67 and 0x66/0x65, read from the templates and the dialog procs' WM_COMMAND/SendDlgItemMessage uses.

name: IDC_PLAY
meaning: Invisible options pass (apply saved settings), then EndDialog.

name: IDC_LBL_VIDEO_DRIVERS
meaning: Hidden static; its text is painted by WM_PAINT.

name: IDC_CMB_DEVICE
meaning: Render device combo; CBN_SELCHANGE refills the modes.

name: IDC_CMB_MODE
meaning: Display mode combo; item data = true mode ordinal.

name: IDC_DBG_WHEEL
meaning: Debug start radio 'Wheel' (checked in WM_INITDIALOG, never read).

name: IDC_CMB_CONTROLLER
meaning: Controller combo; entry 0 = 'Keyboard only', then joysticks.
